the development of a new path planner for cooperative miniature robots, based on the CA model.
the development of a low cost, low computational load and low energy consumption robotic team.

the presented approach is a very promising solution for the aforementioned tasks.
the proposed method could be used for the path planning problem of cooperative miniature robots and for the image resolution enhancement of multiple digital cameras.
this work presents the design and implementation of two algorithms that can be executed concurrently on a team of cooperative miniature robots.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CA based path planning and the image resolution algorithms are suitable for cooperative mini robots.
a CA based cooperative robot team can achieve path planning and image enhancement in parallel, using the resources of every robot.

the proposed CA based method is able to plan collision free trajectories in a team of miniature robots while the image resolution can be increased in order to achieve better results in the further processing stages.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a low computational load algorithm can be used in real cooperative robot systems.
the CA path planning algorithm can be applied to a cooperative robot team and it is suitable for the implementation on a miniature robot platform.
CA can be used as a path planning method for cooperative robots, while it can also be applied as a parallel algorithm for image resolution enhancement.
